question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **Voltrieve Fjord AWD**, a **complete front brake replacement on one side** needs the following parts. The service guide says the Fjord AWD uses **370 mm** front brakes, and the pad set is for the **front axle**, so it covers both sides of the axle.

### Parts needed for the **front axle**
- **VP-10254** - Brake pad set, front axle  
- **VP-10709** - Caliper fitting kit, front axle

- **VP-15168** - Brake fluid DOT 4 LV

question: brakes-spark
answer:

| Part | Article number | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Brake disc, rear right | **VP-10917** | Needed for the side being worked on; 265 mm ventilated brake disc. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Brake pad set, rear axle | **VP-10982** | One set covers both sides of the axle. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Brake caliper, rear right | **VP-11112** | Needed for the side being worked on; single piston floating caliper with integrated parking brake mount. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Caliper carrier, rear right | **VP-11203** | Needed for the side being worked on. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Brake hose, rear right | **VP-11255** | Needed for the side being worked on. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Caliper fitting kit, rear axle | **VP-11307** | One kit for the axle. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Brake dust shield, rear right | **VP-11398** | Needed for the side being worked on. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |
| Brake fluid DOT 4 LV | **VP-15168** | One bottle for bleeding the circuit afterwards. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)* |

The Spark service guide also says the **Voltrieve Spark has no electrical pad wear sensor**, so none is listed for this job. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md)*

question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **Voltrieve Fjord AWD**, the service guide says a **complete front brake replacement on one side** needs the parts below. It also says the Fjord’s front brake parts differ by drive, and **AWD uses 370 mm** fronts. The pad set is for the **whole front axle**, even though you’re working on the left front side. (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

- **Brake disc, front left** - **VP-10072** - 370 mm ventilated brake disc. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Brake pad set, front axle** - **VP-10254** - set of 4 pads for the 370 mm disc, covers both sides of the axle. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Brake caliper, front left** - **VP-10345** - twin piston floating caliper for the 370 mm disc. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Caliper carrier, front left** - **VP-10527** - carrier bracket for the floating caliper. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Brake hose, front left** - **VP-10631** - reinforced flexible hose with banjo fitting. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Pad wear sensor, front left** - **VP-10670** - electrical pad wear sensor. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Caliper fitting kit, front axle** - **VP-10709** - slide pins, bolts and anti-rattle clips for one side. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Brake dust shield, front left** - **VP-10761** - pressed steel shield. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)
- **Brake fluid DOT 4 LV** - **VP-15168** - 1 litre bottle, for bleeding afterwards. (voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

If you want, I can also format this as a short “shopping list” with just the article numbers.

question: brakes-atlas
answer:
For a **complete front right brake replacement on a Voltrieve Atlas (AWD)**, order these parts:

- **1 brake disc, front right** - **VP-10176**. The Atlas front-right disc is 400 mm. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 brake pad set, front axle** - **VP-10267**. The pad set covers both sides of the axle. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 brake caliper, front right** - **VP-10449**. The Atlas uses a six-piston fixed caliper. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 brake hose, front right** - **VP-10657**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 pad wear sensor, front right** - **VP-10683**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 caliper fitting kit, front axle** - **VP-10709**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 brake dust shield, front right** - **VP-10839**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **1 bottle of brake fluid DOT 4 LV** - **VP-15168**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md; voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*

You **do not** need a caliper carrier for the Atlas front brakes, because the service guide says the Atlas has a **fixed caliper**, so there is **no caliper carrier**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md)*

If you want, I can also list the matching **left-side** parts or the **rear brake** parts for the Atlas.
